EDO (PSI 9.4): Gov. Okpebholo approved returning pre-2017 staff to DBS, doubled monthly gratuity subventions to ₦400m, and resolved a communal river dredging dispute.
PLATEAU (PSI 9.3): Banned raw produce sales, launching processed potato branding, cold storage deployment, and a land committee for a Chinese-backed Trade Park.
FCT ABUJA (PSI 9.2): Minister Wike commissioned Gwagwalada Civic Centre, ordered stadium completion, and approved a 50% refund for Airport Expressway pedestrian bridge.
DELTA (PSI 9.0): Reduced legacy debt from ₦463bn to ₦63bn, targeting full clearance by Q1 2027 while launching a 3-day medical outreach for Uzere oil spill victims.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.8): Gov. Fintiri donated ₦35m to FMC Mubi patients, spoke on ethnic militias at NISS, and inspected Kofare road/drainage construction.
GOMBE (PSI 8.7): Gov. Inuwa Yahaya received the Czech Industrial Icon Award, approved a 48% subvention hike for tertiary institutions, and flagged off Fire Safety Week.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.7): EFCC boss commended Gov. Lawal; security neutralized 30 bandits in Bukuyum; 19 Emirs coronated; and 2025 Budget Report showed 72% capital spent.
EBONYI (PSI 8.6): Gov. Nwifuru transmitted an executive bill seeking capital punishment for kidnapping to the House of Assembly following the murder of HRH Eze Francis Igwe.
KADUNA (PSI 8.4): Completed full reconstruction and dualization of Bank Road, Kashim Ibrahim Way, and Abakpa corridor with solar streetlights.
TARABA (PSI 8.3): Gov. Agbu Kefas provided 40 motorcycles, fuel, and food to local border hunters in Karim Lamido following attacks on Binnari.
ONDO (PSI 8.3): Presented appointment letters to 637 absorbed primary school teachers and unveiled fresh TV documentaries to showcase achievements.
ENUGU (PSI 8.2): Gov. Peter Mbah fulfilled his pledge by completing and activating a clean water project in Ebia Ikem community within three weeks.
LAGOS (PSI 8.1): COWLSO conference awarded an apartment to a retiring teacher; Health District V held IPC training; and Chef Hannah won Eko Flavours Season 3.
EKITI (PSI 8.0): Nominated as a top three finalist by PenCom for the 2026 National Pension Award under the CPS implementation category.
BENUE (PSI 8.0): Gov. Hyacinth Alia constituted a 5-member Primary Health Care Board and approved 23 replacement appointments across state boards.
OGUN (PSI 7.9): Marked 42nd Sagamu Day Celebration, highlighting over ₦1bn in financial assistance provided to artisans, traders, and cooperatives.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 7.9): Gov. Umo Eno approved a 13th-month pension bonus and ₦10k welfare, while appointing Mr. Aniefiok Johnson as Chief of Staff.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 7.8): Flagged off the 2026 Calabar Marathon and organized training for evaluators on the new CR-SUBEB Collect App.
RIVERS (PSI 7.6): Gov. Fubara approved the appointment of Eze Sergeant Chidi Awuse as Chairman of the Rivers State Council of Traditional Rulers.
KANO (PSI 7.5): Gov. Abba Kabir Yusuf mourned late businessman Isma'il Maibiskit and completed a neighborhood watch station in Wudil LGA.
